messages:
alia: Support: multiple customers reporting p99 latency spikes in us-west-2 since ~09:40 UTC. Tickets #1234 #1235 #1236. Symptoms: high tail latency, some 504s, increased retry noise.

ben: Oncall: looking now. Grafana p95 jumped 180ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 3.6s. Spike aligns with sustained long-context requests hitting redwood-large-v2.

ravi: eng-sre: seeing queue length grow on runtime pool 'hosted-gpu-usw2-3'. KV cache miss rate up ~4x, GPU utilization at ~95% for that pool.

michelle: eng-runtime: any deploys in the last hour?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete: redwood-large-v2:2026-03-17T09:30Z -> 100%

ben: Ok likely model rollout or workload change. Immediate mitigations I'm recommending: 1) enable circuit breaker on the busy pool to fail fast (429 + Retry-After) if queueing >200ms, 2) rate-limit public endpoints from 100rps -> 60rps as a throttle, 3) route non-enterprise traffic to a smaller fallback model (redwood-medium-quant) in eu-west until we stabilize, 4) increase batch window for low-priority routes to reduce overhead.

alia: Support -> customers: telling them we're actively mitigating, suggested they apply exponential backoff and not flood retries.

ravi: I'll apply CB and the temporary rate limit. Pre-warming fallback model instances now. Command I'll run: `infractl pool set-cb --pool hosted-gpu-usw2-3 --threshold-ms 200 --cooldown-s 60`

michelle: If CB doesn't bring p99 down within 10m I'll start rolling back the model canary to the previous build.

sre-bot: sre-bot: circuit-breaker applied to pool hosted-gpu-usw2-3 (threshold=200ms queue, cooldown=60s)

ben: Routing change in flight: route 30% non-enterprise traffic to redwood-medium-quant (eu-west-1) as fallback. Config snippet:```
route:
  match: tier != enterprise
  fallback_model: redwood-medium-quant
  weight: 0.3
```

ravi: Warmup script kicked off: `scripts/warm_kv_cache.sh --region usw2 --model medium` and starting a small fleet in eu-west-1.

ben: Quick metrics update after changes (5m window): p95 -> 220ms, p99 -> 820ms, error rate dropped ~60%. Keeping monitoring for 15 more minutes.

maria: CS: notified impacted customers, one customer asked about SLA credit process and ETA for full resolution.

alia: Noted. We'll follow up with an incident summary once stabilized. Action items: - ravi to gather traces & slow request samples and keep CB/rate-limit in place until rollback/canary decision; - michelle to prepare rollback if regressions continue; - ben to update routing policies and postmortem runbook; - alia to own customer comms & post-incident notes.

ravi: I'll pull slow traces and save example request payloads for replay: `/debug/traces?from=3512349000&to=3512351200`. Also saving perf counters and kernel logs.

ben: For the runbook update: add explicit guardrail that non-SLA traffic can be transparently downgraded to quantized medium models during p99 spikes, and document CB thresholds + TTLs.

alia: Thanks all — keeping thread open until metrics fully stable and rollback decision made. :white_check_mark:
